scope: Static graphics only; debug IDs are not model inputs

normal_world.meaning: Unit geometric face normal in world coordinates; analytic surface normal for sphere

face_id.meaning: Scene triangle index, or analytic surface slot; used to look up material, not a model input

instance_id.meaning: Debug/evaluation identity; never read by shading or provided to a model

valid.meaning: Valid surface hit within ray-range cutoff

camera.pixel_sampling: Integer column/row, principal point (width/2,height/2), no added half-pixel
